copy.tagline: 掌握 3D 游戏核心开发原理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想系统学习 3D 游戏开发技术
copy.tagline_en: Master 3D game development fundamentals including rendering and physics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are starting to learn 3D game development principles

howto.what: 涉及3D游戏开发时，Claude会按渲染管线、着色器、物理、相机、光照、LOD等原则给出建议，并提醒避免常见的反模式（如滥用网格碰撞器、移动端实时阴影等）。
howto.when: 当你说要开发3D游戏，或询问渲染、着色器、物理、相机、光照等话题时，Claude会依据这套原则来回答。

say.text: 帮我优化这个3D场景的渲染性能。
say.note: Claude会建议使用视锥剔除、LOD、批处理等方法。

say.text: 写一个第三人称相机的平滑跟随脚本。
say.note: Claude会按相机跟随、防碰撞、前视等原则给出代码。

say.text: 水面的特殊效果该用哪种着色器？
say.note: Claude会说明何时需要编写自定义着色器。

howto.what_en: For 3D game development, Claude gives guidance based on principles for rendering, shaders, physics, cameras, lighting, and LOD, and warns against common anti-patterns such as overusing mesh colliders or real-time shadows on mobile.
howto.when_en: When you mention building a 3D game or ask about rendering, shaders, physics, cameras, or lighting, Claude applies these principles in its response.

say_en.text: Help me optimize the rendering performance of this 3D scene.
say_en.note: Claude suggests frustum culling, LOD, batching, etc.

say_en.text: Write a smooth follow script for a third-person camera.
say_en.note: Claude gives code following camera smoothing and collision principles.

say_en.text: Which shader should I use for a water surface effect?
say_en.note: Claude explains when to write a custom shader.
